project.styling: Tailwind CSS 4 plus a shared global stylesheet

designSystem.finding: No design.md, DESIGN.md, tokens.css, tokens.json, or Tailwind config was found. The active design system lives primarily in apps/web/src/styles/index.css.

palette.finding: Terracotta brand colors, forest structural colors, neutrals, semantic states, gradients, shadows, and radii are already defined as CSS custom properties.

motion.finding: Framer Motion is installed and used in welcome, onboarding, campus, building, visitor, student, and tutorial interfaces. A reduced-motion rule exists for global button feedback.

spacing.finding: The UI uses Tailwind's spacing scale together with many arbitrary pixel and fractional values; no shared --space-* token scale was found.

colorFormat.finding: The shared stylesheet contains hex and rgb/rgba colors and no OKLCH tokens. Preserve existing values unless a scoped redesign introduces additive Hallmark tokens.

constraints: Preserve existing routes, components, information architecture, and terracotta/forest brand identity.
Prefer scoped, additive changes over replacing the large shared stylesheet.
Keep reduced-motion support and avoid layout-affecting animation in the 3D viewer.
Do not normalize the full legacy color or spacing system as part of a small visual improvement.
